name: A rematch in a second: BN6's random numbers at a link battle's start
result: Both random words (0x020013F0, 0x02001120) read on both GBAs of the pair a frame at a time through the way in's last two steps: alike on the two GBAs all the way, stepped as on a map until Practice's last confirm; 19 frames after that press the battle draws the first word once and keeps it, 71 frames on puts it back as its opening ends, and the folders are shuffled from the second the frame after. Both words written from a seed at the start of that step change both GBAs' first hands (seed 7: 1636 2448 2448 0201 0605; seed 8: 0236 3459 34af 009a 0236; none: 0001 34c0 0236 0201 2447) and every one of the battle's 44 hashes; the pair kept at that step and gone into again with seed 8 deals seed 8's hands and gives its 44 hashes byte for byte, 244 frames of the pair instead of 1,817.
meaning: A rematch needs no new way in: the pair kept where the bout's seed goes in, and the seed (the battle's ID, known to both players and every spectator) makes each bout its own.
